findings.parkedReason: PARKED VISIBLY, NOT DROPPED (Law 1: recall beats tidiness). PARK RATIONALE CORRECTED 2026-08-18 (review pass) - the original rationale was FACTUALLY WRONG and is superseded. It is NOT true that the phUSD-stable-minter pin is stale: antimatter pins lib/phUSD-stable-minter at d6ed1156, which IS the minter's remote master tip, so THE MINTER PIN IS CURRENT. The stale layer is one level deeper: lib/phUSD-stable-minter/lib/vault is pinned at 043ff2c while vault's remote master is 0110ce4 - 11 commits ahead, including stories 043/044/048/049, which are precisely the commits that introduced deposit() returning creditedPrincipal. What cannot be adjudicated at this commit is therefore WHICH YIELD-STRATEGY / VAULT VERSION IS ACTUALLY DEPLOYED, because this finding depends entirely on the deployed strategy's deposit() return behaviour - not on the minter's version.

findings.parkRationaleCorrection: 2026-08-18 review pass: the original park rationale claimed the phUSD-stable-minter pin was stale. That is false - d6ed1156 is the minter's remote master tip. The stale layer is lib/phUSD-stable-minter/lib/vault @ 043ff2c vs vault master 0110ce4 (11 commits, stories 043/044/048/049). The park stands, but on the corrected ground that the DEPLOYED strategy/vault version is unknown. Severity, status and fingerprint are UNCHANGED by this correction.
findings.recheckInstruction: RE-CHECK INSTRUCTION (corrected): read the DEPLOYED yield strategy - resolved from chain for the stablecoins actually registered - and measure creditedPrincipal versus amount there. DO NOT re-check the phUSD-stable-minter pin: it is already current (d6ed1156 == remote master tip) and re-checking it would wrongly conclude that this park is resolved. The open question is the deployed strategy/vault version, not the minter's. If the deployed strategy's deposit() returns no value or credits the full principal (043ff2c-era behaviour), close as not-applicable. If it credits less than the principal transferred, size the stable leg from the returned value (minter-side fix) and/or have Antimatter assert mintedForStable is within tolerance of minter.calculateMintAmount(stable, stableAmount).
